validation.shutdown_note: Raylet/AsyncEngineDeadError lines appear after replay completion while the wrapper stops Ray; treat as shutdown noise, not a replay failure.

comparison_to_s1_gate.interpretation: Raising max_num_seqs from 1 to 2 improves tail latency and throughput without changing dLoRA scheduling or migration, but service-side engine wait is still the dominant bottleneck.

metadata_audit.issue: The wrapper previously did not write runtime max_num_seqs/max_num_batched_tokens/gpu_memory_utilization/gpu_capacity into deploy metadata, so the summarizer inherited profile defaults.
metadata_audit.repair: The s2 deploy metadata was repaired from the launch envelope and the summary was regenerated; replay data and headline metrics are unchanged.
metadata_audit.future_fix: run_dlora_remote_formal.sh now writes runtime config into deploy/manifest and prints it in launch logs.

decision.reason: The gate is valid and not OOM, but still too slow to represent a best-effort dLoRA formal row. Continue wrapper/runtime envelope sweep before any full 4000-request official replay.
next_fair_steps: Run the same 128-request gate with max_num_seqs=4 if memory permits.
Run a 4-GPU num_groups=4 gate so dLoRA can use the same 4-GPU budget as the closed remote experiments.
Choose the best stable no-core-change envelope before launching the full 3B/4000 official migration_type=3 replay.
